title: AntV Infographic: AI-tuned SVG infographic framework with agent skills
summary: AntV Infographic (@antv/infographic) is an open-source framework for generating and editing SVG infographics from compact template strings, with ~200 built-in layouts, themes, a built-in editor, and a skills/ pack for coding agents.
question_it_answers: How can an agent generate editable SVG infographics from template syntax instead of hand-drawing charts?

claims.text: Infographic ships ~200 built-in templates and AI-tuned syntax that agents emit as compact template strings rendered to editable SVG.
claims.evidence: Features: AI-tuned config/syntax, ready-to-use templates, hand-drawn/gradient themes, editable SVG renderer.
claims.subject: infographics-diagrams

media.description: Wide gallery preview of colorful AntV infographic templates including list, process, and comparison layouts.

judge_hints.why_must_read: Programmable infographic stack with agent skills for non-Mermaid diagrams.
